answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 37835 Country: India Title: Regarding name Laiba Anzar (لا ئبہ انظار ) Question: My daughter name is Laiba Anzar, in urdu I use to write as لائبہ. So I request you to please clear the meaning of this name, the way I use to write in Urdu. Answer ID: 37835 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 567/478/B=1433) Laiba (لائبہ) means thirsty. It also means: a thirsty she-camel. It is better to keep any other good name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
